title: Light in Room Nine  (Luz en la habitación nueve)

segments.t: En la galería de la habitación nueve, Graham envuelve el último empalme con el rollo nuevo de cinta aislante negra mientras Hannah sujeta la escalera y Caleb revisa la placa de la pared. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
Repasemos ahora la escena paso a paso.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
'Pásame los tornillos pequeños de latón de tu bolsillo, Hannah.'
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
'Uno, dos. ¿Está el cable de cobre nuevo conectado hasta la caja?'
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
'Cable totalmente nuevo, fusible de porcelana nuevo y cero tela vieja quedando en la pared.'
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
'La placa de latón del interruptor queda recta y firme contra el ladrillo.'
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
'Baja y apártate de la escalera. ¿Lista para probarla como es debido, Hannah?'
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
'¿Deberíamos llamar a Arthur para que accione el interruptor?'
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
'Ni hablar. Tu turno, Hannah, un clic limpio.'
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
'Allá va... ¡clic! ¡Oh, miren esa cálida luz dorada!'
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
'¡La pantalla de vidrio esmerilado reparte una luz suave por cada cristal de la ventana!'
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
'Escuchen también la cocina: ningún chasquido, y el horno sigue zumbando.'
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
'¡La habitación nueve tiene luz oficialmente después de treinta años a oscuras!'
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
'¡Espera, mira la sombra dentro de la tapa abierta del piano, Hannah!'
Volvamos a escuchar toda la escena de corrido.
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
La lámpara de techo de vidrio esmerilado reparte una luz dorada sin fundir ningún fusible, y su claridad deja ver de pronto una sombra asomando bajo la tapa del piano. Hasta ahora mismo.
See you soon!
